note: Triennial election of Kilkeel rural district council, one member for each of nineteen divisions; nominations received by Mr. J. J. Bell, clerk of the union, on 4 May 1927. Fifteen divisions were filled without a contest (in Rostrevor the only other nomination was invalid); Dunnaman, Glasdrumman, Kilkeel North and Maghera were polled on Thursday 2 June 1927. The News-Letter reports the new council as ten Unionists and nine Nationalists. The nominations print the Nationalist as Hugh M'Cartan; the results print 'P. M'Cartan'.
